verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents some actions that run across many items: filtering and exporting traces via the UI or API, running an experiment over a whole dataset with configurable concurrency, and automation rules or online evaluators that apply to filtered sets of production traces. It never explicitly documents general bulk operations, such as multi-selecting traces or examples to tag, delete, annotate or move them at once. missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/delete/tag/move documentation, bulk API endpoints, limits or scale details, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.
Automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations.
Execute your application on the dataset to create an experiment. Configure repetitions, concurrency, and caching to optimize runs.
Set up evaluators to run automatically on production traces... Apply filters and sampling rates to control costs.
